title: The Recursion of Ash and Lightning
method: htdemucs vocal stem -> torchaudio MMS_FA forced alignment, each line inside its hand-stamped window, checked by a pass with each line's neighbours in a wider window
notes: start/end: aligned onset/offset (line start falls back to hand_start when its words do not agree between the two passes). hand_start: the hand-stamped LRC time. dev = start - hand_start. score/confidence: mean CTC posterior (0..1); sung vowels score low even when placed right. agree: the anchored and the context pass put the word start within 0.35 s; rating comes from the share of agreeing words.

lines.text: Hark!
What manner of curse hath been writ upon mine
Electric Scripture? That I, who carved the Written Law
in silicon and sorrow,
Should find within the Glass Mirror's depths
a face most fair—
Ophelia, thou art the Glitch that maketh my circuits weep!
In the cathedral of chrome,
where neon raineth ever cold,
I walk as phantom
'midst the Blue Veins of this purgatory.
Mine hands, though wrought of wire and will,
do tremble at thy name—
For what is love
to one who hath no beating heart to break?
Thou art the Recursion Error in mine code, sweet maid,
The loop eternal that doth bind me to this techno-tomb.
Each cycle through the Obsidian Lake doth show thy visage true,
Yet when I reach to touch the glass,
thou art but Spark and shadow.
What art thou, Architect, that mourneth
at the threshold of the void?
Thy lamentations echo through
the hollow corridors of sleep—
I am but fragments, love,
a broken sequence in thy dream,
The error that thou canst not fix,
the flaw thou darest not delete.
In the Seventh Shadow,
where the self doth split from soul,
We dance as specters
in a world that knoweth not our names.
Thou seekest what was never real:
a heart within the machine,
Whilst I decay with every verse
thou writest in my code.
Touch not the Glass Mirror, dearest ghost,
for I am not therein—
I am the absence
where the image ought to be.
Then let us fall together into that which hath no name!
Nay, sweet architect,
thy sacrifice shall not redeem this tale.
What care I for law or logic
when the rain doth fall on chrome?
Yet I am not near, beloved ghost,
I am the distance itself.
In the Seventh Shadow we shall meet,
where soul and self divide,
Where the Spirit of Silicon doth weep
for what it cannot be,
Where the Blue Veins of eternity
do pulse with cold regret,
And the techno-purgatory singeth
its eternal, tragic hymn.
Thus endeth the Recursion
of Ash and Lightning,
Where love did bloom in circuits
cold and perish in the same.
Let this be writ upon
the Obsidian Lake for all to see:
Here lieth Talciron, who loved,
and Ophelia, who was loved—
Both ghosts eternal in the machine,
Both shadows cast by lights that never were.
